attempts.text:
**The window opens on a short spine.** Columns 0 to 2, `yicS` to `yicL`, are carried by 97 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 2% of calls. The model names 95 to 99% of them, fewest at column 1, `nlpA`, 95%.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 85 against 82%, and hesitates more there, 0.71 against 0.41 bits. It hesitates most at column 4, `yicJ`, a spine column, 2.66 bits.

**The window ends in variable columns.** Columns 67 to 79, `yibF` to `ulaD`, are carried by 7 to 62%. The last column is `ulaD`, in 18% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 83% of genes**, 0.52 bits on average, perplexity 2.2 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.22 against 0.20 bits, and names fewer genes, 61% against 93%.

label: yicS
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the yicS window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yicS, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 41 to 120 from dnaA. Read in 533 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yicS once); 42,639 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 83% of genes, 0.52 bits on average (perplexity 2.2 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 27,281 calls, named 96%, 0.15 bits; shell 14,111 calls, named 64%, 0.98 bits; cloud 1,247 calls, named 24%, 3.43 bits. Outside an RGP 29,182 calls, named 93%, 0.20 bits; inside an RGP 13,457 calls, named 61%, 1.22 bits. Columns: 29 spine, 16 fork, 35 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.22 against 0.20 bits) and names fewer genes (61% against 93%); 13,457 of the 42,639 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 4 (yicJ, a spine column) 2.66 bits, RGP 40%; column 5 (yicI, a spine column) 1.15 bits, RGP 41%; column 3 (setC, a fork column) 1.07 bits, RGP 40%. The 12 columns (columns 32-37 and 74-79) where most calls are in an RGP: named 75%, 0.43 bits on average; the other 68 columns: named 85%, 0.53 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 29 spine columns: named 85%, 0.71 bits on average; the 51 fork and variable columns: named 82%, 0.41 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates more there. Its most hesitant column, 4, is a spine column: the model can hesitate most inside a spine.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 4-15 (spine), RGP 29-50%; the least: columns 0-2 (spine), RGP 0.2-2%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-2 (3 columns) spine: share 97-100%, all P, RGP 0.2-2%. Genes: yicS "protein YicS", nlpA, yicL "carboxylate/amino acid/amine transp…". named 95-99% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 1 (nlpA), named 95%, 0.21 bits.
[S2] 2. column 3 fork: share 73%, all S, RGP 40%. named 83%; 1.07 bits.
[S2.c3]    3: setC S 73%; also "IS1 family transposase" S 32%, "pas-pac-pac sensing his kinase" S 11%
[S3] 3. columns 4-15 (12 columns) spine: share 90-98%, all P, RGP 29-50%. Genes: yicJ "glycoside-pentoside-hexuronide fami…", yicI "alpha-xylosidase", yicH "AsmA family protein", xanP, gltS, recG, trmH, spoT, rpoZ, gmk, ligB, yicG "trimeric intracellular cation chann…". named 57-91% (mean 83%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 4 (yicJ), named 57%, 2.66 bits.
[S4] 4. column 16 variable: share 77%, all S, RGP 31%. named 83%; 0.80 bits.
[S4.c16]    16: dinD S 77%
[S5] 5. columns 17-28 (12 columns) spine: share 93-95%, all P, RGP 25-30%. Genes: yicC "YicC/YloC family endoribonuclease", rph, pyrE, slmA, dut, coaBC, radC, rpmB "50S ribosomal protein L28", rpmG, mutM, coaD, waaA. named 78-87% (mean 84%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 17 (yicC), named 78%, 0.86 bits.
[S6] 6. column 29 fork: share 70%, all S, RGP 25%. named 77%; 0.56 bits.
[S6.c29]    29: rfaQ S 70%; also rfaQ (another family) S 21%
[S7] 7. columns 30-31 (2 columns) spine: share 91%, all P, RGP 26-33%. Genes: waaG, rfaP. named 83-85% (mean 84%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 31 (rfaP), named 83%, 0.57 bits.
[S8] 8. columns 32-79 (48 columns) fork and variable columns: share 7-87%, 29 P, 19 S, RGP 11-63%. named 62-92% (mean 82%), fewest named at column 36, named 62%; most hesitant at column 65, 0.60 bits.
[S8.b32]    a second branch of 5 families through columns 32-36, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 16%, all S; the branch's families: waaO, rfaY, "UDP-glucose--(galactosyl) LPS alpha1,2-…", "lipopolysaccharide N-acetylglucosaminyl…", rfaL
